core_obligations: Surjectivity: the quotient morphism from the covering space onto the stack is surjective, flat and locally of finite presentation, hence surjective on points by the corresponding characterization (proof lines 4134-4141)

The relation: the groupoid space is the fibre product of the quotient morphism with itself, so its points map onto the pairs of points of the covering with the same image in the stack (proof lines 4142-4149)

Conclusion: the image of the groupoid space in the square of the covering is exactly the equivalence relation, and since the map on points is surjective the space of the stack is the quotient by it (proof lines 4150-4154)
proof_roadmap: 由平坦群胚的商栈构造，p: U → X 满、平坦、局部有限表现 ⇒ |U| → |X| 满。
故 |R| → |U| × |U| 的像恰是「像点相同」的对 ⇒ |X| 是 |U| 对该等价关系的商。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that for a flat groupoid in algebraic spaces the space of the quotient stack is the quotient of the space of the covering by the equivalence relation induced by the groupoid space (author lemma at source lines 4125-4132, label lemma-points-presentation). The proof (source lines 4134-4155) uses that the quotient morphism is surjective on points, identifies the groupoid space as the fibre product of that morphism with itself, and reads the equivalence relation off the induced map on squares (proof lines 4134-4154). The identification of the relation through the fibre product description is the content. H3.
